control.description-key: Stage file uploads on a Create form and persist them as Notes once the record is saved.

property.name: value
property.description-key: Internal JSON state used by the control. Bind to a Multiline Text column dedicated to this control.

property.name: documentFileFieldLogicalName
property.description-key: Logical name of the Dataverse File column where the uploaded document will be stored.

property.name: allowMultipleFiles
property.description-key: If disabled, only a single file may be staged/attached at a time.

property.name: allowedExtensions
property.description-key: Comma-separated list of allowed file extensions, e.g. .pdf,.docx,.png

property.name: allowedMimeTypes
property.description-key: Comma-separated list of allowed MIME types.

property.name: maxFileSizeKB
property.description-key: Maximum allowed size per file, in kilobytes. Default is 10240 KB (10 MB).

property.name: maxFileCount
property.description-key: Maximum number of files that may be staged/attached in total.

property.name: displayMode
property.description-key: Dropzone: the current large drag-and-drop card. Button: a compact modern button showing the file name (or file count when multiple).

property.name: buttonIdleLabel
property.description-key: Label shown on the trigger button before any file is staged or attached. Only used when Display mode is Button.

property.name: labalColor
property.description-key: Hex color used for the Labal dropzone/button/links/badges, e.g. #0078d4.

property.name: accentColor
property.description-key: Hex color used for the dropzone/button/links/badges, e.g. #0078d4.

property.name: showPreviewThumbnails
property.description-key: Render image/PDF/text thumbnails in file cards instead of always using the generic type icon.

property.name: showFileMeta
property.description-key: Show the size and MIME type line under each file name.

property.name: allowPreview
property.description-key: Show the preview action on already-attached files.

property.name: allowDownload
property.description-key: Show the Download action on already-attached files.

property.name: allowDelete
property.description-key: Show the Delete/Remove action on files (staged or already attached).

property.name: confirmBeforeDelete
property.description-key: Ask for confirmation (native Dataverse dialog) before deleting an attached file.

property.name: replacePCFWithSelectedFiles
property.description-key: Replace PCF Control With Selected Files

property.name: hideControlAfterUpload
property.description-key: Once a file is successfully uploaded / the Note is created, hide this control own field on the form. Requires Enable Xrm integration.

property.name: showDocumentFieldAfterUpload
property.description-key: Once a file is successfully uploaded, show the Dataverse File column field (Document File Field Logical Name) on the form. Requires Enable Xrm integration.

property.name: deleteNoteAfterFileFieldUpload
property.display-name-key: Delete Note after File column upload
property.description-key: Single-file mode with a Document File Field set only. True (default): only upload to the File column, no Annotation/Note is created at all. False: also create/keep an Annotation (Note) copy of the file alongside the File column value, as a redundant audit-trail copy.
